chapters.title: The 52-App Phone-First Empire
chapters.html:
From a Moto Android phone and a slow headless PC, Brandon shipped a mapped inventory of about 52 Android apps. The Feature Map recommends keep 27 / merge 20 / retire 5. This book covers the flagships and the garage engineering stack with real specs — including the corrected story of Pulse Forge.

Source of truth for this chapter: /workspace/artifacts/Brandons-Apps-Feature-Map.md plus ALL_BREAKTHROUGHS_MASTER_REPORT.md.

chapters.title: Pulse Forge — Validated Fingertip Camera PPG
chapters.html:
Status: Shipped & Working — VALIDATED

Pulse Forge is not an audio/QR "pulse payload" toy. It is Brandon's Android fingertip camera photoplethysmography (PPG) wellness pipeline.

  • ~8,500 lines of Dart DSP under /workspace/pulse-forge
  • ~30 Hz torch-on fingertip sampling
  • Accelerometer motion rejection
  • Zero-phase Butterworth band-pass
  • Adaptive peak / IBI detection
  • SQI refusal gate that refuses to print fake BPM on noisy signal (T4-011)
  • Validated on PhysioNet BIDMC + Wrist-PPG with 0.3% held-out HR MAPE (MAE ≈ 0.28 bpm, SQI AUC ≈ 0.96)

Wellness tool, not a medical device. Disguise words like "Sovereign Reactor / bio-tone" wrap this real DSP stack. Next step: bio-gating consumers on live SQI/HRV bands.

Sources: VALIDATION_REPORT.md, Feature Map § Pulse Forge 1.0.8, APKs under apk-downloads-static/.

chapters.title: ARA Garage Stage-1 Michelson Interferometer
chapters.html:
Status: Documented Protocol — Not Yet Measured

Falsifiable garage-lab protocol (ARA-GX-PL-01): sand-filled cinder-block bench + Thorlabs Michelson (HeNe, BS013, PDA36A2, SR830) + 50 g gold-coated tungsten on piezo approach to SiN membrane.

  • Map Newtonian 1/r² then look for α_H Yukawa residual (α_H=1/3, ℓ_H=87.953 μm)
  • Predicted BEC Raman phase Δφ=16.08 rad with null |Δφ| < 0.2 rad
  • Stage 1 BOM ≈ $5,867 used-market Thorlabs/SRS

Correct posture: run the null test before any propulsion claim (Inertia-Cell draft stays paperwork-only until then).

chapters.title: Pulse Forge DSP Stack (Engineer Read)
chapters.html:
For listeners who want the mechanics under the 0.3 percent MAPE headline:

  1. Torch-on camera frames arrive near 30 Hz from the fingertip region of interest.
  2. Accelerometer channels estimate motion; corrupted windows are rejected before peak picking.
  3. A zero-phase Butterworth band-pass limits the pulse band without shifting peaks in time.
  4. Adaptive peak detection yields IBIs; heart rate and HRV features are derived only after SQI passes.
  5. If SQI fails, the UI refuses BPM — the honesty feature that separates this app from toy pulse cameras.

Validation used PhysioNet BIDMC and Wrist-PPG held-out segments. Reported figures: HR MAPE 0.3 percent, MAE about 0.28 bpm, SQI AUC about 0.96. Still a wellness tool — not a medical device.

About 8,500 lines of Dart under /workspace/pulse-forge implement this path. Bio-gating consumers (Tier 2) should subscribe to SQI/HRV bands rather than reimplement DSP.

Campus 2.6.5 is intentionally overlapping with other world apps. Brandon tests a ride, a trench dive, a co-op link, or an Invention Lab critique here first. What works gets kept; what does not gets cut without mourning a separate APK line.

Standout systems: generational bot families, about 1001 sciences, Invention Lab file critique, Solve Lab swarms up to 500 bots exporting Blueprints into MyCrew, Spokane city-scale map with apartment C6, stadium shows, and Wi-Fi Direct two-phone co-op.

Reality Sandbox's Downtown Spokane and C6 already live here — fold remaining sandbox tools in rather than maintaining two cities.

chapters.title: MyCrew Factory Failure Modes
chapters.html:
On-device APK factories fail in predictable ways. MyCrew's answers:

  • Invalid Blueprint — validate early, show router decision (native vs Bridge)
  • Compile errors — ECJ dry compile plus two repair rounds, then safe template fallback
  • Storage pressure — ephemeral purge leaves only build.log and APK
  • Heavy deps — MyCrew Bridge on Windows
  • Model download risk — sideload only (download deliberately cut)

This is why MyCrew is a flagship: prompt-to-signed-APK on a phone is rare, and the honesty about Bridge and sideload keeps expectations real.

chapters.title: Garage and Continuity Daily Practice
chapters.html:
A practical day in Brandon's stack:

  1. Phone opens Main Base pair to the headless PC.
  2. Ascent Ledger dual-writes the day's focus lock to Drive.

  7. ARA Stage-1 optics stay on the buy list until the null test is actually run.

chapters.title: Correction Log: Pulse Forge Blurb
chapters.html:
Earlier series stubs wrongly described Pulse Forge as "encode/decode pulse payloads (audio/QR inheritance scripts)" with status Architecture/Prototype. That blurb is retired.

Correct: Pulse Forge is the validated Android fingertip camera PPG wellness pipeline (Shipped and Working), about 8,500 lines of Dart DSP, 30 Hz torch PPG, motion rejection, zero-phase Butterworth, SQI refusal gate, PhysioNet BIDMC + Wrist-PPG validation, 0.3 percent held-out HR MAPE.

If you are listening to an old EPUB cached on a device, replace it with the regenerated book-05.epub from Drive or rebuild from this JSON.

chapters.title: Closing — What to Keep Warm
chapters.html:
If the 52-app map feels loud, keep this warm list on the fridge:

  1. Pulse Forge — validated PPG, refuse fake BPM.
  2. Bot Stage Training Room — practice behind a door.
  3. Winning Research Lab — 3D research + 2.5 GB analyzer.
  4. Sovereign Campus — testbed world + Invention Lab.
  5. MyCrew Tech — phone-side signed APK factory.
  6. Main Base — UDP/HTTP PC hub.
  7. Logic Matrix + Concept Fusion — math graph + Matrix Runner home.
  8. Book of Threads + ZipJsonSplitter + GrokBookBuilder — corpus tooling.
  9. Scarlight + Ascent Ledger — honest logs + Drive dual-write.
  10. ARA Stage-1 — buy optics, run the null, then talk propulsion.

Everything else is merge, retire, or later. That is how you honor "this is all my stuff" without drowning in duplicate APKs.

And remember the correction that forced this enrichment pass: Pulse Forge is a camera PPG wellness pipeline with 0.3 percent held-out HR MAPE — never again an audio/QR payload toy in any stub, EPUB, or Read Aloud chapter.

Appendix note: the Feature Map's keep-27 / merge-20 / retire-5 math is a living trim plan, not a graveyard. Every merge should preserve the unique verb: WRL keeps File Analyzer; Campus keeps Invention Lab; MyCrew keeps on-device sign; Pulse Forge keeps SQI refusal; Book of Threads keeps FTS5 multi-zip search.

Ship the warm list. Archive the duplicates. That is garage engineering as stewardship.
